messages:
maya: saw an unexpected auto-fallback today on /nlp/encode. only a short blip of 502s but the console moved the route to hard-degrade and paged on-call :grimacing:

jon: hard-degrade? that sounds like threshold stacking gone wrong. do we still treat cache_miss+5xx as an immediate escalator?

maya: yeah, the policy combined signals and used a max-of strategy. a 30s spike in 502 plus kv_miss ratio > 0.6 triggered escalate path.

ritesh: proposal: change decision math to weighted-sum with a noise floor. short spikes should be downweighted unless they persist for Xs. also add a spike_guard that requires either duration >= 45s OR sustained avg > threshold for two consecutive windows.

lia: for UX: console needs to show the exact decision formula used (compact) and the contributing weights. Operators shouldn't have to read docs to interpret "combined_signal".

samir: agree. tiny JSON blob in the audit row is fine, but we must keep it compact. e.g. decision_blob = "policy:soft_v3;score:0.82;contributors:5xx:0.6,kv_miss:0.22;reason:duration=30s"

maya: that format works. can we also include a short human line like "why: 5xx spike + cache miss" for quick reading?

jon: yes. and add a stability_hint field: "hysteresis_left=25s" so operators know when to expect reversion.

ops-bot: note: paging threshold temporarily suppressed for routes with <100rps to reduce noise.

lia: inbox change: bundle all degrade events for the same route into a single thread with counts and a small timeline. provide a one-click snooze (5m/30m/1h) that writes an annotation to the audit log.

ritesh: retention concern: audit rows should only store IDs and compact blobs. full traces go to a sampled-store with TTL 7d and 0.5% default sampling. on-call can bump to 5% via an expiring token.

samir: cost math check: 0.5% sampling at peak 1M rps still big. we should sample only degraded requests and errors, not everything. suggested: sample_rate = max(0.005, min(0.05, degraded_rate * 0.01)).

maya: another ask: decisioning API `/v1/decision?route=/nlp/encode&window=30s` should return compact string fields only (no nested JSON) so the console can render without custom parsing. e.g. response: "policy=soft_v3;decision=degrade;score=0.82;hysteresis=25"

jon: and developer-facing SDK should expose a parse helper. also, audit rows need role-based links to the sampled payload; only SREs and on-call can fetch.

lia: console mock: show small badge "DEGRADED" + tooltip with top3 signals, score, and a button "Fetch sample" (disabled unless your role allowed). include inline CTA "Force immediate revert" but gated by RBAC + reason required.

ritesh: one more safety: add an oscillation detector that prevents re-degrade within 2x the previous hysteresis if flips happen >3 times in 10m. helps avoid thrashing.

maya: sounds good. action items: ritesh -> PR for weighted-sum math + spike_guard; jon -> spec decision endpoint and compact blob format; lia -> inbox bundle mock + RBAC states; samir -> update sampling/cost calc and retention table. I'll draft a one-paragraph runbook for on-call that lists steps: check decision_blob -> view sampled payload -> snooze vs escalate.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: soft-degrade-policy-weighted-sum -> canary 5% at 20:10 UTC :rocket:
